newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias elects three new board members.
newsitem.headline: Victorias elects three new board members.

text.p: Cash-strapped Victorias Milling Co said on Thursday three new members were elected to its board of directors.
The new board members Teodorico Escober, Ramon Benedicto and Eduardo Lim replaced three people who resigned last month.
One of those who resigned was Victorias president Gerardo Javellana.
Javellana was replaced by Manuel Manalac as president of the sugar milling firm.
Victorias has sought a moratorium on the principal payment of its 4.42 billion pesos debt from 32 local and foreign creditors.
Its trading arm, North Negros Marketing Co Inc, recently filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) a petition for suspension of loan payments.
The Land Bank of the Philippines had foreclosed some properties of North Negros in partial payments of its debts worth 465.62 million pesos.
